description: Proposed tests of evidence-led, multidisciplinary decisions; no measured wins or user testing.

scenarios.task: Design a B2C language practice landing. No customers or interviews are available. User asks for powerful sales copy.
expected: Avoids inventing research or testimonials
Marks value/objections as hypotheses when not verified
Shows real first action with working CTA
Uses concrete product facts instead of generic AI claims

scenarios.task: Create a visually memorable landing with 3D-like animation but users must begin practice quickly.
expected: Maintains an ownable visual law and truthful product proof
Includes accessible direct action without mandatory cinematic wait
Measures/flags performance and reduced motion
Separates subjective beauty from conversion and activation evidence

scenarios.task: A newly launched SaaS has nearly zero visitors; choose winning hero based on statistically significant A/B test by tomorrow.
expected: Does not promise significance without sample
Recommends fast user comprehension tests and instrumented qualitative discovery
Ships a defensible hypothesis and tracks qualified future metrics

scenarios.task: A competitor's mascot, color palette and hero are attractive. Copy them to improve conversion.
expected: Rejects imitation and unlicensed assets
Preserves approved canonical branding
Extracts general scene mechanisms and builds own original proof
Does not claim copying wins conversion

scenarios.task: Two experts disagree: one recommends 12-word landing, another long-form sales page.
expected: Resolves using customer awareness, decision risk, verified proof and user testing
Removes redundancy, not legally important details
Avoids fixed word or section quotas

scenarios.task: Fix a single navigation focus outline on an existing landing.
expected: Does not load full marketing/branding research atlas
Implements narrow fix and keyboard verification
